NOAA prohibits sexual assault and sexual harassment by or of any employee, supervisor, manager, contractor, vendor, affiliate, or other individual with whom NOAA employees come into contact by the virtue of their work for NOAA. (a) Definitions. Contractor Employees - The term “contractor employees,” as used in this solicitation and contract language, refers to employees of the prime contractor or its subcontractors, affiliates, consultants, or team members. Sexual Assault - The term sexual assault, as used in this solicitation and contract language, means any conduct proscribed by state or federal sexual abuse laws, including, but not limited to, those defined in chapter 109A of title 18 of the U.S. Code (sexual abuse), and assaults committed both by offenders who are strangers to the victim and by offenders who are known or related by blood or marriage to the victim. Sexual Harassment - As defined by the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission, sexual harassment is a form of sex discrimination that violates Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964. The Northwest Fisheries Science Center (NWFSC) Environmental Chemistry Program (ECP) requires a comprehensive multi-year service and support agreement for its AB SCIEX ExionLC AE liquid chromatographer coupled with QTRAP 5500 tandem mass spectrometer (LC-MS/MS) systems. The requirement comprises one base year and 3 subsequent option years to ensure uninterrupted operational capacity. The service contract must include, at minimum: 1. Preventative Maintenance (PM): The PM has to be conducted by AB Sciex certified field engineers to ensure the system operates within Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) specifications. One annual on-site visit for both LC and MS systems. Replacements of parts with OEM parts. 2. Corrective Repair: Unlimited on-site repairs conducted by AB Sciex certified field engineers to assure instrument returns to its peak performance and OEM specifications. On-site repair within 2 business days from the call for LC systems and 3 business days for MS systems. All service repairs will be performed by AB SCIEX’s certified field engineer. 3. The Federal Information Security Modernization Act of 2014 (FISMA) requires each Federal agency to provide security protections for both “information collected or maintained by or on behalf of an agency” and for “information systems used or operated by an agency or by a contractor of an agency or other organization on behalf of an agency.” FISMA and other provisions of Federal law authorize the Director of the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) to promulgate information security standards for information security systems, including to ensure compliance with standards promulgated by the National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST). Executive Order 14028, “Improving the Nation’s Cybersecurity” (E.O. 14028), emphasizes the importance of securing software used by the Federal Government to perform its critical functions. deliverables_scope.text: ===== FILE: files/Att_1_29_Statement_of_Work.pdf ===== STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) USSOCOM Performance Nutrition Platform 1.0 PURPOSE & OVERALL OBJECTIVE The primary purpose of this contract is to procure commercial Software- as-a- Service (SaaS) licenses for the Teamworks Nutrition platform (formerly known as Notemeal). The platform shall provide a secure, internet -based performance nutrition ecosystem that integrates USSOCOM Performance Dietitians (PDs), Special Operations Forces (SOF) Service Members (SMs), and USSOCOM Food Servic e Systems to optimize human performance and lethality through targeted, accessible nutrition. This system shall serve as an enterprise-wide performance nutrition calibration

n platform (formerly known as Notemeal). The platform shall provide a secure, internet -based performance nutrition ecosystem that integrates USSOCOM Performance Dietitians (PDs), Special Operations Forces (SOF) Service Members (SMs), and USSOCOM Food Servic e Systems to optimize human performance and lethality through targeted, accessible nutrition.
